annotation.title_clean: Executive Order 14409: Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security
annotation.title_en: Executive Order 14409: Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security
annotation.authors_or_issuer: The White House (President of the United States)
annotation.summary_en: US Executive Order of June 2, 2026 promoting AI innovation and security. It directs agencies to harden federal systems, create an AI cybersecurity clearinghouse, set up a voluntary framework for government pre-release access to covered frontier models, and prioritize prosecution of AI-enabled cybercrime, while rejecting mandatory licensing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Agencies must prioritize cyber defense of National Security Systems and federal information systems within 30 days.
Treasury, War/NSA and DHS/CISA to form a voluntary AI cybersecurity clearinghouse for vulnerability scanning and patching.
Classified benchmarking process to designate 'covered frontier models'; NSA Director makes the determination.
Voluntary framework for developers to give government up to 30 days pre-release access to covered frontier models.
Explicitly no mandatory licensing, preclearance or permitting for AI model development or release.
